meta.source: NASA LRO LOLA polar gridded elevation (PDS Geosciences Node) + PGDA 5 m/pixel site maps
meta.method: ray-march per azimuth on a 1737.4 km sphere with bilinear sampling; finest map first
meta.reference: Mazarico, E., Neumann, G. A., Smith, D. E., Zuber, M. T., Torrence, M. H. (2011), Illumination conditions of the lunar polar regions using LOLA topography, Icarus 211, 1066-1081

polarMap.projection: south polar stereographic, 0° longitude up, 90°E right (seen from below)

pgda-site01.name: Connecting ridge (PGDA Site01)
pgda-site01.note: Best landing point inside NASA PGDA's 5 m/pixel LOLA map Site01 (Connecting ridge), chosen by Clearway: highest NASA average sunlight with 90% of the ground within 50 m below 8°. Site numbering follows Mazarico et al. (2011).
pgda-site01.source: PGDA product 78, tile Site01_final_adj_5mpp_surf.tif; point selected by Clearway (highest NASA average sunlight with 90% of the ground within 50 m below 8°)

selection.rule: highest NASA average sunlight with 90% of the ground within 50 m below 8°
